description: Live cost of the same transaction on Base, OP Mainnet, Arbitrum One and Ethereum, in USD and ETH, ranked cheapest first. Costs about $0.01. Each call makes a real USDC micropayment on Base mainnet via x402 from BUYER_PRIVATE_KEY; payments above MAX_USD_PER_CALL are refused. Do not call it in loops.

gasLimit.description: Gas units to price. 21000 ETH transfer (default), ~65000 ERC-20 transfer, ~85000 NFT mint, ~180000 Uniswap swap, ~1500000 contract deploy.
